verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's docs mention 'conversational interfaces' alongside semantic search and embeddings, hinting at some AI-generated-answer capability, but there is no dedicated documentation, example, or hands-on evidence showing it actually produces AI-generated insights or suggestions from a user's data (as opposed to returning ranked/matched documents). missing for 10: dedicated docs or examples of a conversational/insights feature, evidence of it generating summaries or recommendations, independent corroboration that this works in practice.
